items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: How did Jelly Roll Morton happen to be on it? INTERVIEWEE: Wingy was Wingy. He was weird. Wingy would find people. He dug up people.

ctx.x: Wingy Manone, with Jelly Roll Morton on piano.
Yeah, and Chick I think was on drums? [No. Kaiser Marshall was on drums]
